item.text: {"branches":[{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if the independently recomputed adjusted artifact-to-tool ratio does not vary consistently with translation effectiveness after controlling for script complexity, educational support, and media recognition.","hypothesis_id":"H1","intervention":"Recompute digitized_artifacts_count divided by deciphering_tools_count, then adjust by inverse script complexity and positive indicators for educational_program_availability and media_representation; compare with effective_translations_score.","mechanism":"Greater digitized-artifact coverage per deciphering tool supplies more usable evidence, while lower script complexity and stronger educational and media support improve translation effectiveness.","mechanism_key":"resource_support_positive","predictions":[{"direction":"positive","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted ratio shows no positive association or shows a negative association with effective_translations_score.","observable":"Association between adjusted artifact-to-tool ratio and effective_translations_score","prediction_id":"P1","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if translation effectiveness is unrelated to the adjusted ratio or increases mainly when complexity and support are unfavorable.","hypothesis_id":"H2","intervention":"Apply the same recomputation and controls, testing whether higher artifact-to-tool coverage reduces effectiveness because available tools are insufficient for the volume and complexity of material.","mechanism":"A high artifact-to-tool ratio may indicate bottlenecked tooling; complex scripts and weak educational or media support amplify the bottleneck.","mechanism_key":"resource_bottleneck_negative","predictions":[{"direction":"negative","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted ratio is positively associated with effective_translations_score after the specified controls.","observable":"Association between adjusted artifact-to-tool ratio and effective_translations_score","prediction_id":"P2","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if the association remains clearly positive or negative after accounting for nonlinearities and interaction effects among complexity, education, and media recognition.","hypothesis_id":"H3","intervention":"Recompute the ratio and evaluate a threshold or interaction model in which artifact-to-tool coverage matters only under particular combinations of script complexity, educational support, and media recognition.","mechanism":"Translation effectiveness may be constrained by interacting resources, producing weak or heterogeneous relationships rather than a uniform directional effect.","mechanism_key":"conditional_nonlinear_effect","predictions":[{"direction":"conditional_or_null","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The relationship is uniform and directionally consistent across complexity, educational support, and media-recognition strata.","observable":"Stratified or interaction-dependent association between adjusted artifact-to-tool ratio and effective_translations_score","prediction_id":"P3","value_range":null}]}],"budget_units":3,"question":"What is the relationship between translation effectiveness and the digitized-artifacts-to-deciphering-tools ratio after adjustment for script complexity, educational support, and media recognition?"}
